scientific_question: Does removing the measured cross-expert decoder conflict let an expert-specific nonlinear coordinate field co-generate every c_fc/c_proj neuron pair at greater than 200x compression?

theory_reconciliation.measured_failure: The sealed shared-decoder field recovered only 0.106893/0.099240 heldout output and negative JVP, while its discovery output errors remained 0.879--0.950 and JVP errors 1.001--1.006. This is representation failure, not heldout overfit.
theory_reconciliation.causal_evidence: The earlier paired-direction audit measured mean cross-expert decoder-gradient cosine -0.14218 and cancellation ratio 2.65e-4. Expert-specific neuron codes did not remove the only shared orientation object: the decoder weights.
theory_reconciliation.single_change: Replace the one layer-shared coordinate decoder by eight expert-specific decoders. Reduce each neuron code from six to three coordinates so the complete learned state remains above 200x compression.
theory_reconciliation.paired_function: Each expert-specific decoder emits both a_j[k] and b_j[k] from the same neuron code and fixed channel coordinate, preserving the hidden-neuron gauge in y_e(x)=sum_j b_ej GELU(a_ej^T x+q_ej).
theory_reconciliation.not_lora_or_dense_basis: No dense target matrix, dense base, additive residual, or learned channel dictionary is retained. Decoder weights, expert-neuron codes, hidden biases, and per-expert scales are all counted.
theory_reconciliation.mapping_connection: This remains a smooth layer-wise latent-to-parameter map, but permits the separate expert manifolds demanded by the measured routed-gradient conflict.

source.terminal_gauge: Use the exact terminal model, routing, dense c_fc/c_proj teacher, and fixed token banks from the sealed shared-decoder oracle.

candidate.name: expert_specific_paired_neuron_coordinate_field
candidate.channel_encoding: The same fixed 17-vector [t,sin(pi*2^r*t),cos(pi*2^r*t)] for r=0..7 used by the favorable control.
candidate.router_scope: The existing top-2 router remains an independently counted non-target component; both matrices of all eight experts are generated.

data_protocol.sampling: Reuse exact terminal routing and deterministic per-expert sampling; no new data seed, token window, or occupancy policy.
data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and JVP probes never affect coordinates, stopping, scales, or selection.

fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on all counted expert-specific field coordinates
fit_protocol.objective: The identical equal-expert normalized residual-output MSE plus 0.10 normalized analytic input-JVP MSE used by the sealed favorable control.
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. No heldout selection, retry, code/decoder/rank/frequency/LR/seed/step sweep, or threshold adjustment.

evaluation.primary: Exact routed dense-teacher residual-output recovery on the untouched terminal heldout activations.
evaluation.local: Analytic input-JVP recovery on the same independent frozen Rademacher protocol.
evaluation.expert: Score every expert before top-2 mixture aggregation.
evaluation.stability: Compare heldout routed actions from independently fitted discovery A/B fields by cosine.

decision_rule.pass: Passing every gate in both banks authorizes only implementation/count/correctness work and a separately preregistered initialization-plus-Mapping-Loss shadow; it does not authorize LM training directly.
decision_rule.fail: Reject expert-specific 20-56-56-2 coordinate fields with three-code neurons. Do not sweep code width, decoder width/depth, frequencies, LR, seed, steps, or thresholds. A failure closes per-neuron implicit weight-coordinate decoding at the 200x boundary and requires an architecture-level latent function rather than another coordinate field.
